description: In a document that keeps the `development` pack, take units by `ref`: `planned` to `in_progress` with `taken_by`, the git `branch` they are taken on and `started` (default today), the batch refused unless every one is still planned. With `take_over`, take units already `in_progress` from that taker — a session that stopped mid-unit — refused unless each is held by exactly that taker; `started` is reset and the taker replaced is kept on `taken_over_from`. Writes nothing until `commit: true`.

branch.description: The git branch they are taken on.

commit.description: Write it. Omit or false for the dry run.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

take_over.description: The `taken_by` whose claim this replaces, for units already in progress.

taken_by.description: Who takes them: the host’s name for its session.

name: claim_units
title: Claim units
